newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain crash kills 10; most victims Japanese.
newsitem.headline: Spain crash kills 10; most victims Japanese.

text.p: A minibus filled with Japanese tourists collided with a van on Tuesday close to the cathedral town of Toledo, killing 10 people and seriously injuring four, police said.
Police said the two vehicles burst into flames after the collision, trapping some of the passengers inside and burning them to death in their seats.
"A van swerved off the motorway into traffic travelling in the other direction and collided with the minibus which burst into flames," a police spokeswoman said.
The minibus had 13 occupants, 11 Japanese tourists, one Spanish guide and a driver, who were travelling from a hotel in Madrid to visit the popular tourist sites of Toledo, the police spokesman said.
Nine of the people in the minibus were burned to death. The other victim was riding in the van. The accident took place on a busy motorway 30 km (20 miles) south of Madrid.
A government spokesman said bodies were so badly burned that emergency workers had been unable to identify them.
